title: Repo growth
description: Daily GitHub activity for the past year: stars, forks, issues and traffic. KPIs compare the last 30 days with the 30 days before.

panels.title: New stars (last 30 days)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM github_stars)
SELECT
  sum(new_stars) FILTER (WHERE date > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS stars,
  sum(new_stars) FILTER (WHERE date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND date > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS stars_prev
FROM github_stars, a

panels.title: New forks (last 30 days)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM github_stars)
SELECT
  sum(new_forks) FILTER (WHERE date > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS forks,
  sum(new_forks) FILTER (WHERE date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND date > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS forks_prev
FROM github_stars, a

panels.title: Net new open issues (last 30 days)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM github_stars)
SELECT
  sum(issues_opened - issues_closed) FILTER (WHERE date > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS net_open,
  sum(issues_opened - issues_closed) FILTER (WHERE date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND date > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS net_open_prev
FROM github_stars, a

panels.title: Unique visitors (last 30 days)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM github_stars)
SELECT
  sum(unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE date > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS visitors,
  sum(unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE date <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND date > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS visitors_prev
FROM github_stars, a

panels.title: Cumulative stars and forks gained
panels.description: Running total since the start of the data (the CSV has no starting totals).
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date,
  sum(new_stars) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS stars,
  sum(new_forks) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS forks
FROM github_stars
ORDER BY date

panels.title: Weekly new stars and forks
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('week', date) AS week,
  sum(new_stars) AS new_stars,
  sum(new_forks) AS new_forks
FROM github_stars
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly issues opened vs closed, PRs merged
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('week', date) AS week,
  sum(issues_opened) AS issues_opened,
  sum(issues_closed) AS issues_closed,
  sum(prs_merged) AS prs_merged
FROM github_stars
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Open issue backlog growth
panels.description: Cumulative issues opened minus closed since the start of the data.
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date,
  sum(issues_opened - issues_closed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS net_open_issues
FROM github_stars
ORDER BY date

panels.title: Weekly traffic
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('week', date) AS week,
  sum(page_views) AS page_views,
  sum(unique_visitors) AS unique_visitors
FROM github_stars
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stars by top referrer of the day
panels.sql:
SELECT
  top_referrer,
  sum(new_stars) AS stars
FROM github_stars
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Biggest star days
panels.sql:
SELECT
  date,
  new_stars,
  new_forks,
  page_views,
  unique_visitors,
  top_referrer
FROM github_stars
ORDER BY new_stars DESC
LIMIT 15
